transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. Can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me?

Um… I guess work sent me. At the warehouse I’ve been doing stuff they don’t like, like… stopping by the forklift with my arms up, or copying the beeps and hand signals. Sometimes I move boxes around in little patterns. People yell at me to stop, so… yeah.
Have you been doing these kinds of repetitive movements and behaviors since you were a child, or did this start more recently?
Not since I was a kid. It’s more… recent, I guess. Maybe the last six months or so, with the talking getting mixed up and the stuff at the warehouse.

When you copy those beeps and hand signals or freeze with your arms up, do you feel like you have to do it to stop something bad from happening, or does it just happen without any particular worry behind it?

It’s not really like I’m trying to stop something bad. It just… happens. I’ll be by the forklift and my arms go up, or I start copying the beeps and signals, and then people are yelling at me to quit. Sometimes I move the boxes into little patterns too. I don’t know why.
Have you noticed anything unusual lately, like hearing voices that other people don't hear, or having thoughts or beliefs that others tell you don't make sense?
I don’t know. I mean… not really voices, I guess. People say I’m not making sense sometimes, but I’m not sure what you mean by beliefs.
In the past six months, have you had any new medical problems—like an infection, head injury, seizures, or starting/stopping any drugs, alcohol, or medications—around the time these movements began?
I don’t think so. Nothing I can point to like that… no big thing around when it started. I’m not really sure.

You mentioned your talking has been getting 'mixed up'—can you describe what that's like? For example, do you find yourself losing track of what you're saying, or do others tell you your sentences don't connect logically?

Yeah… I guess I lose the line of it. Like my supervisor asks which pallets go on the truck, and I start answering, but then I’m talking about the load sheet, then my old house, then fishing or… church boxes. It feels connected when I start, but people just look at me like they don’t know what I’m saying.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts or actions were being controlled by someone or something outside of you, or that people could read your mind?
I don’t know… controlled, like by a person? I haven’t really noticed that. Mind reading sounds… I don’t think so. I’m not sure what you mean exactly.
Have you or anyone around you noticed things like muscle stiffness, tremors, fevers, sweating, or your heart racing around the time these episodes happen?
I haven’t really noticed that. Nobody’s said anything to me about fevers or my heart or… stiffness. I don’t know, I guess I don’t pay close attention.
Do you have any ongoing health conditions—like thyroid problems, seizures, diabetes, or an autoimmune disease—or has a doctor mentioned any new medical diagnosis in the past several months?
Not that I know of. I haven’t been told I have any of those things or anything new recently.
During these episodes, do you ever feel confused about where you are, what day it is, or who the people around you are?
I don’t think so… I usually know where I am. I’m not really paying attention to the day sometimes, but I don’t think I get confused like that.
Do you ever feel that something unusual is happening to you that others don't understand—like people are watching you, plotting against you, or that you have special powers or a special purpose?
I don’t know… I mean, sometimes things feel off, but I’m not sure what you mean. I don’t really want to get into all that.
I’m not really sure. Sometimes I just get uneasy, but… I don’t know how to explain it.
Have you noticed yourself feeling less interested in things you used to enjoy, or pulling away from friends and family, since this all started?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I haven’t really been keeping track. I still talk to people sometimes. I just… keep to myself more, I guess.

You mentioned things sometimes feel 'off'—can you tell me more specifically, like do you believe someone or something is trying to harm you, or that you have some special ability or purpose that others don't understand?
I don’t really know. I wouldn’t say it like that… like, harm me or special powers. It’s more just… things feel weird sometimes, and I get uncomfortable. I don’t have a good way to explain it.
Does anyone in your family have a history of schizophrenia, psychosis, or other serious mental illness?
I’m not really sure. My family doesn’t really talk about that kind of stuff… I haven’t heard of anyone being diagnosed with something like that.
I’m not sure what you mean… I don’t really have anything else to say about that.
Have you ever heard sounds or voices—like someone talking or making noise—when no one else was actually there?
Not really… I mean, I don’t think so. Sometimes I hear little noises and I’m not sure where they came from, but voices, like someone talking to me… I haven’t really noticed that.
Have you or anyone close to you noticed any new physical changes recently—like weakness, trouble walking steadily, memory lapses, or coordination problems?
I don’t think so… I haven’t really noticed anything like that. I mean, I get tired sometimes, but nothing with walking or… coordination, I guess.

During these episodes of freezing or repeating movements, do you or others notice your level of alertness changing—like becoming drowsy, confused, or 'foggy'—compared to when you're not having an episode?

I don’t know if I get foggy exactly. People at work say I kind of… stop, like freeze with my arms up by the forklift, or I’ll copy the beeps and hand signals. Sometimes I’m moving boxes around in these weird little patterns and they’re yelling at me to stop, but I’m not really thinking about it much.
